sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Table 1 (p.1) gives ALCAM (120-word survey list) as the only source for Evant; p.2 sec.3: 'For Tivoid languages, phonologies of any sort exist for only three languages, Tiv, Esimbi and Ugarə.' The only prosodic remark (p.2) is 'Tiv and Ugarə are two-tone languages.. Esimbi has three tones'; Evand appears only as an untone-marked wordlist column and in the Central Tivoid A subgrouping.
